products.title: Dreamer Duvet Cover - Satin Navy
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
This duvet cover from Cinderella is made of 100% cotton, woven in satin weave. This gives the fabric a wonderfully soft, supple and smooth feel and a subtle silk sheen. The matching pillowcases are finished with a stylish Oxford flounce on 3 sides, giving a luxurious look. Cinderella duvet covers feature a full-width double tuck-in strip, making them suitable for duvets up to 220 cm long. Cinderella duvet covers come with matching pillowcases in 60x70 cm size. Single duvet covers come with 1 pillowcase, the other sizes include 2 pillowcases. Besides the cotton-satin duvet covers, Cinderella also has plain cotton-satin fitted sheets, sheets and pillowcases in the range in the same colours where you can mix and match for a beautiful whole.

Specifications

Material
100% Cotton satin
Pillowslips
Fitted with oxford border
Closure
Full width stopper strip
Duvet length
Suitable for duvets up to 220 cm
Washing instructions
Wash up to 60 degrees, dry at low temperature
Quality mark
Oeko-TEX® certified
